title: Stadium
description: stadium.yaml: the tables of the tournament battle overlay (STD_REL.BIN).

opponent_base_stats.description: STD_OPPONENT_BASE_STATS: the base stat of the opponents, by tournament (STD_initializeOpponent).

grades.description: STD_GRADES: the TIM of each tournament's grade (STD_initializeTournament).

win_chances.description: The chance of each outcome by the levels of the two fighters, [level A - 3][level B - 3] (STD_setupParticipants).

camera_presets.description: Six values each, passed in order to the overlay's setCameraParams.

arenas.description: The arenas with files: the model, TIM and collision paths and how many objects and TIMs they hold (loadArenaAssets; the counts live in the executable).

bracket.description: The bracket drawn between matches (std_main.c: STD_updateBracket, STD_renderBracketDigimon, STD_renderBracketProjectile). Missing in an older extraction.

row_y.description: STD_BRACKET_ROW_Y: the y of each step up the bracket, from the screen's centre.

hop_y.description: STD_BRACKET_HOP_Y: the winner's hop, added to its row's y frame by frame.

paths.description: STD_BRACKET_PATHS: by slot, the x of each step and whether the sprite faces right there.

sprite_palettes.description: STD_DIGIMON_SPRITE_CLUT: the palette of each species' bracket sprite.

projectile_icons.description: STD_BRACKET_PROJECTILE_ICONS: each species' shot icon (1 = the first).

projectile_palettes.description: STD_BRACKET_PROJECTILE_CLUTS: the palette of each shot icon (icon - 1).
